scope: Untrained interface prototype only, not a third trained candidate. Neural two-slot query/source alignment, predicted initial route and per-step token-position readout. No claimed subject/relation semantics before training.
inputs: Fresh C encoding of natural query and supplied source separately; exact 0.5B identity. No gold spans, query strings, labels or source text in neural forward or generation prompt.
payload_policy: Only whole C token pieces wholly inside the JSON text field, whose unescaped bytes exactly match natural text, may copy. Escaped text fails closed for copy. Control tokens and framing excluded; boundary-overlapping tokens excluded. No retokenization or normalization claims.
native_panel: First lexicographically sorted training world, both languages, original/swapped_values/wrong_subject. Six supplied-source records; two unique query texts and six source texts. Fresh extraction, no feature-bank fallback. Empty source and disabled branch separately checked.
checks: Exact C token IDs and byte reconstruction; query bytes unchanged across source interventions; no gold fields in adapter
Only neural attention selects payload positions; changing payload IDs without changing features cannot affect matching or position weights (synthetic unit check only)
Empty/all-ineligible/disabled bypass exactly preserves base logits; wrong-route copy suppressed, without claiming untrained wrong-subject detection
Duplicate token positions sum probability mass, special tokens excluded, normalized mixture, finite gradients to matching/position/gate
Reply-local state bound to module/input identity and tensor versions; mutations and cross-module reuse rejected
Retain all untrained route predictions; no threshold/seed/weight search and no semantic success gate
